title: Open--closed recollement
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and an integer $n\geq1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Z,U,X$ be schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible, let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] with $j(U)=X\setminus i(Z)$. Work on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For a scheme $W$ write $D(W_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ for the ordinary, uncompleted derived category of modules over the constant ring sheaf $A_W$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations; def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

Write $i^*,j^*$ for the finite-level derived pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], which are the exact module inverse images applied termwise, and write $Ri_*$ for the derived direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Use extension by zero $j_!$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero], exact by [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-exact], also for its termwise induced functor on ordinary derived categories [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Let $\varepsilon_j:j_!j^*\to\operatorname{id}$ be the natural transformation induced by the sheaf counit of $j_!\dashv j^*$ [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-adjunction]: apply the counit in each degree [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy] and descend along localization at quasi-isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]. Let $\eta_i:\operatorname{id}\to Ri_*i^*$ be the unit of the derived adjunction $i^*\dashv Ri_*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations].

For $K\in D^b_c(X,A)$, meaning that $K$ has finitely many nonzero cohomology sheaves, all constructible in the finite-torsion sense [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], the specified open--closed pair is

$$
 j_!j^*K\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{j,K}}K\xrightarrow{\eta_{i,K}}Ri_*i^*K.
$$

An *open--closed recollement triangle for $K$* is a morphism

$$
 \delta:Ri_*i^*K\longrightarrow (j_!j^*K)[1]
$$

such that

$$
 j_!j^*K\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{j,K}}K\xrightarrow{\eta_{i,K}}Ri_*i^*K\xrightarrow{\delta}(j_!j^*K)[1]
$$

is a distinguished triangle [def-weil-triangulated-category; def-weil-abstract-derived-category] in $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$. This defines the data and its required property; existence of such a $\delta$ and preservation of the constructible subcategories are separate assertions, not assumptions or conclusions of this definition.

Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$, an integer $n\in\mathbf
Z_{\geq1}$, and put $A=A_{E,n}$. Let $Z,U,X$ be schemes on which $\ell$ is
invertible. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion
[def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] and let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be its
complementary open immersion. Write $i^*,j^*$ for the derived pullbacks
[def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and use the exact
extension-by-zero functor [def-weil-extension-by-zero] $j_!$ and the derived
direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image] $Ri_*$ on the small pro-etale
sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $K\in D^b_c(X,A)$, a
bounded complex with the finite-torsion constructibility condition
[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], the canonical open--closed pair
of maps is

$$
 j_!j^*K\longrightarrow K\longrightarrow Ri_*i^*K,
$$

given by the open counit and the closed unit. An *open--closed recollement
triangle* means a distinguished triangle extending this specified pair.
